# Channels

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Connect a WhatsApp number

- **What it is:** Connect a WhatsApp Business number through Meta's signup window; it needs a Meta Business Portfolio.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > Add channel > WhatsApp
- **The agent can:** create a link that connects the number with no login, with `create_number_connect_link` (Full access)
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/connect-whatsapp.md, section "embedded-signup-step-by-step". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/connect-whatsapp#embedded-signup-step-by-step

## Keep using the WhatsApp Business app (Coexistence)

- **What it is:** One number works in the WhatsApp Business phone app and in Whatsable at the same time, with messages in both.
- **Plan:** Every plan. Chosen at the QR step of the signup. History import covers about 6 months of one-to-one chats and is offered once.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins, during the WhatsApp connection.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > Add channel > WhatsApp
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/whatsapp-business-app.md, section "connect-the-number". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/whatsapp-business-app#connect-the-number

## Connect Instagram or Messenger

- **What it is:** Connect an Instagram professional account, or Facebook Pages for Messenger; their chats land in the same inbox.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro and Agency. Bulk Message connects WhatsApp only. The trial and the Free plan allow every channel.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > Add channel > Instagram or Messenger
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** no docs page yet. No docs page describes connecting Instagram or Messenger yet; the steps are in the app. Closest page: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers

## Add a chat widget to a website

- **What it is:** A chat widget for a website; its conversations land in the same inbox and an AI agent can answer them.
- **Plan:** Every plan. It does not use one of the plan's channels.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > Add channel > Website chat
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/website-chat.md, section "add-a-widget-to-your-website". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/website-chat#add-a-widget-to-your-website

## Pause or resume a number

- **What it is:** Pause stops sending from a number and makes its chats read-only until Resume.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > the number's menu > Pause or Resume
- **The agent can:** read each number's status with `list_numbers`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers.md, section "pause-unlink-or-delete-a-number". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers#pause-unlink-or-delete-a-number

## Check a number's health with Meta

- **What it is:** What Meta last reported about a number: Available, Limited, Blocked or Not checked.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels > the number's menu > Check what Meta reports
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers.md, section "what-meta-reports". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers#what-meta-reports

## How many numbers a plan includes

- **What it is:** How many numbers the plan includes, and which are over it.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins open Channels. The owner adds numbers to the plan.
- **Where:** Settings > Channels
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers.md, section "how-many-numbers-your-plan-includes". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started/business-numbers#how-many-numbers-your-plan-includes
